main_text.head: Dedicatio.
main_text.p: tionem perveniendi, sit voluntas, ac etiamnum genuinæ infistamus viæ, prægrandis sese offert mediorum, experimentorum, aliorumque ad iter hoc conficiendū requisitorum, aut penuria, aut difficultas, aut ignorantia: Quibus amovendis omninò consenescimus, ac fato cedimus, fitque ὁ βίος βεβαχὺς, ἡ ἡ πέχνη μακρὰ. Et licet quam multi, quorum de meliori luto pectus efformatum, herculeo verè ausu, isti jam inveteratæ querelæ medelam afferre conati sint, nondum tamen superata omnis difficultas; adeo ut penè insuperabilis ea videatur. Inter omnia vero media, quibus in hac caligine adspiramus ad accuratam omnium quasi rerum notitiam, & τὸ πάντα εἰδέναι, (quo ὠδὲν γλυκύπικρον; & quo sublato tollitur omnis ratio, & vitæ degendæ, & rerum agendarum, Cicer. 1. fin. ac cui

page.notes: Greek words in the text are transcribed as far as legible; the accents of the second Greek line (ὁ βίος, ἡ τέχνη, μακρά, ὠδὲν, γλυκύπικρον) are uncertain. The last line "cui" is set flush right and is the catchword-like continuation; it is included once in the main text above and should be checked for duplication. Some letters in the scan are blurred.
